spine.deviation_notes: Abyss pull-detonate is a composite mechanic (pull + DoT + detonate) that maps to vortex_pull but loses the DoT phase between pull and detonate. Engine vortex_pull is a CC delivery; the damage-DoT-then-explode texture is fidelity loss.

skills.delivery_notes: Placed at target location: pulls enemies in, deals AoE damage over time, then detonates. Magic damage type. MW1-close: d2 magic-damage = element-NEUTRAL. Pull mechanic = vortex_pull geometry. Batch hot-fact: Terror Zone language in dossier is CONTENT context, not fear attestation (§0.4 discipline) — no fear emitted.
Supplemental AoE magic-damage skill. Element-neutral (magic-damage). Large zone delivery.
Capstone skill: 'creates a field within which monsters automatically die' — execute-threshold field. Attested in capstone_alterations.

mapping_json.motion_frame: Cast Abyss to pull-and-detonate enemy clusters; supplement with Miasma skills; Sigil: Death for field-execute capstone.
mapping_json.fidelity_notes: All magic-damage skills map element-neutral per MW1-close ruling. Terror Zone farming context is NOT fear attestation per §0.4 and batch hot-facts — no fear token emitted. Abyss pull-then-detonate is a vortex_pull geometry (nearest to its pull+explode behavior). GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE for the detonation identity. Sigil: Death execute-field is aspirational capstone via execute ailment in a zone — no execute ailment emitted on Abyss (not attested on Abyss specifically); Sigil:Death attested separately. Consume (sacrifice demon) noted but not a primary damage verb — scaffold economy.
